description.short_caption: Chest CT scan showing cavitary lesion in the right lung.
description.detailed_description: This axial chest CT image demonstrates a cavitary lesion in the right lung, with surrounding consolidation and possible air-fluid level. The mediastinum and left lung appear unremarkable. The image is presented in a lung window setting, highlighting pulmonary parenchymal abnormalities.
visible_findings: cavitary lesion in the right lung
normal appearance of the left lung

description.short_caption: Chest CT scan showing bilateral pulmonary findings.
description.detailed_description: This axial chest CT scan demonstrates bilateral lung abnormalities. There are areas of ground-glass opacities and consolidation, particularly in the right lung, with some sparing of the left lung. The mediastinum and central airways appear patent. The scan is in a lung window setting, highlighting parenchymal changes.
visible_findings: consolidation more prominent in the right lung

description.short_caption: Axial T2-weighted MRI of the brain showing hyperintense lesions.
description.detailed_description: This axial T2-weighted MRI of the brain demonstrates hyperintense lesions in the periventricular white matter. The ventricles appear symmetrically enlarged, and the surrounding brain parenchyma shows abnormal signal intensity. The image is well-centered and provides clear visualization of the cerebral hemispheres and midline structures.
visible_findings: hyperintense lesions in periventricular white matter
abnormal signal intensity in brain parenchyma

Case_02053/figure6.jpg.source_caption: Methenamine silver stain of right leg skin biopsy.

description.short_caption: Methenamine silver stain of skin biopsy showing fungal elements.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a methenamine silver stain of a skin biopsy. The stain highlights fungal elements, which appear as dark black or brown structures against a greenish background. The fungal forms include round yeast-like cells and branching hyphae, consistent with fungal infection. The staining technique enhances the visibility of fungal cell walls, aiding in diagnosis.
visible_findings: dark black or brown fungal elements

Case_02053/figure8.jpg.source_caption: Lactophenol blue stain (80x), photo by Lynn Bry, M.D.

description.short_caption: Lactophenol blue stain showing fungal hyphae and conidia.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a lactophenol blue stain at 80x magnification. The fungal structures include septate hyphae and conidia, which are stained blue. The hyphae are long, filamentous, and branching, while the conidia are oval and clustered. The stain highlights the fungal morphology, aiding in identification.

Case_02053/figure7.jpg.source_caption: Lactophenol blue stain (40x), photo by Lynn Bry, M.D.

description.short_caption: Lactophenol blue stain showing fungal hyphae and conidia at 40x magnification.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a lactophenol blue stain at 40x magnification. The fungal structures include septate hyphae and oval-shaped conidia, which are stained blue. The hyphae appear filamentous and branch at acute angles, while the conidia are arranged in clusters or singly along the hyphae. The background is clear, highlighting the fungal elements.
